Lakers off to a 14-7 start in Detroit. Austin Reaves has a couple of makes, and Quentin Grimes has found his shot. He has a pair of threes.

Pistons have adjusted to using Ausar as a screener with Kessler on him. Mixed in inverted P&R as well. 

Lakers seeing how teams have pressured Reaves getting him off ball to start. Get him off screens let him get it back late. Intrigued if denials slow them down.
Pistons out here making the Lakers look like the best defense in the MenBA.
